title: What I learned working on Airbnb's hosting team: search, reviews and response rate, from Airbnb's own pages
summary: How Airbnb search ranking, response rate, reviews, Guest Favorites and cancellations work, from Airbnb's public pages, and what each means for hosts.
body_markdown:
**I spent 6 years at Airbnb as a staff data scientist on the hosting team. I can't share anything confidential from that time, and this post doesn't. What I can do is point at what Airbnb itself says publicly about search ranking, reviews, response rate and cancellations, and explain why those rules exist and what they mean for a host. Almost everything that moves your listing is written down on Airbnb's own help pages. Most hosts just haven't read them closely.**


Every fact below comes from an official Airbnb page, linked, checked on November 19, 2026. Airbnb changes these pages, so check the links before you act on them.
